hebrewText: וְ/אֵ֣לֶּה מַלְכֵ֣י הָ/אָ֡רֶץ אֲשֶׁר֩ הִכָּ֨ה יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ וּ/בְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל בְּ/עֵ֤בֶר הַ/יַּרְדֵּן֙ יָ֔מָּ/ה מִ/בַּ֤עַל גָּד֙ בְּ/בִקְעַ֣ת הַ/לְּבָנ֔וֹן וְ/עַד הָ/הָ֥ר הֶ/חָלָ֖ק הָ/עֹלֶ֣ה שֵׂעִ֑ירָ/ה וַ/יִּתְּנָ֨/הּ יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ לְ/שִׁבְטֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל יְרֻשָּׁ֖ה כְּ/מַחְלְקֹתָֽ/ם

tokens.bdb: these or those
tokens.kjv: an-(the) other; one sort, so, some, such, them, these (same), they, this, those, thus, which, who(-m).

tokens.bdb: a king
tokens.kjv: king, royal.
tokens.explanation: melek — rei, governante, soberano de um povo ou nação

tokens.bdb: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] common, country, earth, field, ground, land, [idiom] natins, way, [phrase] wilderness, world.
tokens.explanation: eretz — terra, solo, país, região, toda a terra

tokens.bdb: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
tokens.kjv: [idiom] after, [idiom] alike, as (soon as), because, [idiom] every, for, [phrase] forasmuch, [phrase] from whence, [phrase] how(-soever), [idiom] if, (so) that ((thing) which, wherein), [idiom] though, [phrase] until, [phrase] whatsoever, when, where ([phrase] -as, -in, -of, -on, -soever, -with), which, whilst, [phrase] whither(-soever), who(-m, -soever, -se). As it is indeclinable, it is often accompanied by the personal pronoun expletively, used to show the connection.
tokens.explanation: asher — pronome relativo: que, quem, o qual, cujo

tokens.bdb: to strike (lightly or severely, literally or figuratively)
tokens.kjv: beat, cast forth, clap, give (wounds), [idiom] go forward, [idiom] indeed, kill, make (slaughter), murderer, punish, slaughter, slay(-er, -ing), smite(-r, -ing), strike, be stricken, (give) stripes, [idiom] surely, wound.

tokens.bdb: Jehoshua (i.e. Joshua), the Jewish leader
tokens.kjv: Jehoshua, Jehoshuah, Joshua. Compare H1954 (הוֹשֵׁעַ), H3442 (יֵשׁוּעַ).

tokens.bdb: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
tokens.kjv: [phrase] afflicted, age, (Ahoh-) (Ammon-) (Hachmon-) (Lev-) ite, (anoint-) ed one, appointed to, ([phrase]) arrow, (Assyr-) (Babylon-) (Egypt-) (Grec-) ian, one born, bough, branch, breed, [phrase] (young) bullock, [phrase] (young) calf, [idiom] came up in, child, colt, [idiom] common, [idiom] corn, daughter, [idiom] of first, [phrase] firstborn, foal, [phrase] very fruitful, [phrase] postage, [idiom] in, [phrase] kid, [phrase] lamb, ([phrase]) man, meet, [phrase] mighty, [phrase] nephew, old, ([phrase]) people, [phrase] rebel, [phrase] robber, [idiom] servant born, [idiom] soldier, son, [phrase] spark, [phrase] steward, [phrase] stranger, [idiom] surely, them of, [phrase] tumultuous one, [phrase] valiant(-est), whelp, worthy, young (one), youth.
tokens.explanation: ben — filho, descendente, membro de um grupo (bar em aramaico)

tokens.bdb: Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity
tokens.kjv: Israel.
tokens.explanation: Yisrael — nome dado a Jacó (aquele que luta com Deus)

tokens.bdb: properly, a region across; but used only adverbially (with or without a preposition) on the opposite side (especially of the Jordan; ususally meaning the east)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] against, beyond, by, [idiom] from, over, passage, quarter, (other, this) side, straight.

tokens.bdb: Jarden, the principal river of Palestine
tokens.kjv: Jordan.

tokens.bdb: a sea (as breaking in noisy surf) or large body of water; specifically (with the article), the Mediterranean Sea; sometimes a large river, or an artifical basin; locally, the west, or (rarely) the south
tokens.kjv: sea ([idiom] -faring man, (-shore)), south, west (-ern, side, -ward).
tokens.enLiteralWord: a sea  or large body of water; specifically
tokens.explanation: yam — mar, lago, oceano, ocidente (o mar fica a oeste)
tokens.explanationEn: a sea  or large body of water; specifically

tokens.bdb: Baal-Gad, a place in Syria
tokens.kjv: Baal-gad.

tokens.bdb: properly, a split, i.e. a wide level valley between mountains
tokens.kjv: plain, valley.

tokens.bdb: Lebanon, a mountain range in Palestine
tokens.kjv: Lebanon.

tokens.bdb: as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with)
tokens.kjv: against, and, as, at, before, by (that), even (to), for(-asmuch as), (hither-) to, [phrase] how long, into, as long (much) as, (so) that, till, toward, until, when, while, ([phrase] as) yet.

tokens.bdb: a mountain or range of hills (sometimes used figuratively)
tokens.kjv: hill (country), mount(-ain), [idiom] promotion.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a mountain or range of hills
tokens.enLiteralWord: a mountain or range of hills
tokens.explanation: a mountain or range of hills
tokens.explanationEn: a mountain or range of hills

tokens.bdb: Chalak, a mountain of Idumaea
tokens.kjv: Halak.

tokens.bdb: to ascend, intransitively (be high) or actively (mount); used in a great variety of senses, primary and secondary, literal and figurative
tokens.kjv: arise (up), (cause to) ascend up, at once, break (the day) (up), bring (up), (cause to) burn, carry up, cast up, [phrase] shew, climb (up), (cause to, make to) come (up), cut off, dawn, depart, exalt, excel, fall, fetch up, get up, (make to) go (away, up); grow (over) increase, lay, leap, levy, lift (self) up, light, (make) up, [idiom] mention, mount up, offer, make to pay, [phrase] perfect, prefer, put (on), raise, recover, restore, (make to) rise (up), scale, set (up), shoot forth (up), (begin to) spring (up), stir up, take away (up), work.

tokens.bdb: Seir, a mountain of Idumaea and its aboriginal occupants, also one in Palestine
tokens.kjv: Seir.

tokens.bdb: to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.)
tokens.kjv: add, apply, appoint, ascribe, assign, [idiom] avenge, [idiom] be (healed), bestow, bring (forth, hither), cast, cause, charge, come, commit, consider, count, [phrase] cry, deliver (up), direct, distribute, do, [idiom] doubtless, [idiom] without fail, fasten, frame, [idiom] get, give (forth, over, up), grant, hang (up), [idiom] have, [idiom] indeed, lay (unto charge, up), (give) leave, lend, let (out), [phrase] lie, lift up, make, [phrase] O that, occupy, offer, ordain, pay, perform, place, pour, print, [idiom] pull, put (forth), recompense, render, requite, restore, send (out), set (forth), shew, shoot forth (up), [phrase] sing, [phrase] slander, strike, (sub-) mit, suffer, [idiom] surely, [idiom] take, thrust, trade, turn, utter, [phrase] weep, [phrase] willingly, [phrase] withdraw, [phrase] would (to) God, yield.
tokens.explanation: natan — dar, entregar, conceder, pôr, colocar

tokens.bdb: Jehoshua (i.e. Joshua), the Jewish leader
tokens.kjv: Jehoshua, Jehoshuah, Joshua. Compare H1954 (הוֹשֵׁעַ), H3442 (יֵשׁוּעַ).

tokens.bdb: a scion, i.e. (literally) a stick (for punishing, writing, fighting, ruling, walking, etc.) or (figuratively) a clan
tokens.kjv: [idiom] correction, dart, rod, sceptre, staff, tribe.

tokens.bdb: Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity
tokens.kjv: Israel.
tokens.explanation: Yisrael — nome dado a Jacó (aquele que luta com Deus)

tokens.bdb: something occupied; a conquest; also a patrimony
tokens.kjv: heritage, inheritance, possession.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: something occupied; a conquest; also a patrimony
tokens.enLiteralWord: something occupied; a conquest; also a patrimony
tokens.explanation: something occupied; a conquest; also a patrimony
tokens.explanationEn: something occupied; a conquest; also a patrimony

tokens.bdb: a section (of Levites, people or soldiers)
tokens.kjv: company, course, division, portion. See also H5555 (סֶלַע הַמַּחְלְקוֹת).
